name: 國二・二段 英文寫作題練習卡
source: 高雄楷模書院練習卷・八上英文 康／翰／南 B3 L3～L4 的改寫、重組、翻譯、填充題；看題目後按「看答案」自我檢查

questions.q: she had / some tea / breakfast. / drank / Mom / after （句子重組）
questions.ans: Mom drank some tea after she had breakfast.
questions.e: 媽媽在她吃完早餐後喝了一些茶。

questions.q: Emma exercised after she finished her homework. （用 before 改寫句子）
questions.ans: Emma finished her homework before she exercised.

questions.q: when / I / be / in / the / bookstore / yesterday / I / meet / Ivy（完成句子）
questions.ans: When I was in the bookstore yesterday, I met Ivy.
questions.e: 連接詞 when 表「當……的時候」，又本句為描述過去的事，故 be 動詞及 meet 都用過去式。

questions.q: Lily listened to music before she did her homework. （用 after 改寫句子）
questions.ans: Lily did her homework after she listened to music.
questions.e: 先聽音樂再做功課，所以 after 子句的動作為聽音樂。又 after 放句中時，不須用逗號隔開。

questions.q: Before she went to the park, she went to the library. （用 after 改寫句子）
questions.ans: She went to the park after she went to the library.
questions.e: 先去圖書館再去公園，所以 after 子句的動作為去圖書館。

questions.q:
（畫線部分請看下圖）
She practiced for a long time before she became a famous player.（依畫線部分造原問句）
questions.ans: What did she do before she became a famous player?
questions.e: 畫線的部分為在成為知名運動員之前的行為，所以用疑問詞 what。

questions.q: after / Kevin / practice / a year / he / win / the race （完成句子）
questions.ans: After Kevin practiced for a year, he won the race.
questions.e: 連接詞 after 表「在……之後」，所以後面子句用過去式。

questions.q: After Kate ate the cake, she drank some tea. （用 before 改寫句子）
questions.ans: Kate ate the cake before she drank some tea.
questions.e: 先吃蛋糕再喝茶，所以 before 子句的動作應為吃蛋糕；又 before 放句中時，不須用逗號隔開。

questions.q: Alice went to bed after she brushed her teeth. （用 before 改寫句子）
questions.ans: Alice brushed her teeth before she went to bed.
questions.e: 先刷牙再睡覺，所以 before 子句的動作應為睡覺；又 before 放句中時，不須用逗號隔開。

questions.q: when / I / be / in / the / bookstore / yesterday / I / meet / Ivy（完成句子）
questions.ans: When I was in the bookstore yesterday, I met Ivy.
questions.e: 連接詞 when 表「當……的時候」，又本句為描述過去的事，故 be 動詞及 meet 都用過去式。

questions.q: Joyce 在三十歲的時候成為一位老師。
questions.ans: Joyce became a teacher when she was thirty (years old).
questions.e: 兩件事同時發生，要用連接詞 when 連接。兩子句的時態須一致，均使用過去簡單式。

questions.q: Jane 在起床之後，她有一個想法。(After…)
questions.ans: After Jane got up, she had an idea.
questions.e: 表示時間「在……之後」的連接詞用 after 表示。

questions.q: Nancy 在吃午餐前，她洗了她的手。(Before…)
questions.ans: Before Nancy had lunch, she washed her hands.
questions.e: 表示時間「在……之前」的連接詞用 before 表示。

questions.q: 在我們起床前，我爸爸洗了車。
questions.ans: Before we got up, my dad washed the car.
questions.e: 表示時間「在……之前」的連接詞用 before 表示。

questions.q: 你完成功課後就可以拉小提琴。 (…after…)
questions.ans: You can play the violin after you finish your homework.
questions.e: 表示時間「在……之後」的連接詞用 after 表示。

questions.q: was / video games / Roy / playing / last night. / at ten o’clock（句子重組）
questions.ans: Roy was playing video games at ten o’clock last night.
questions.e: Roy 昨晚十點在玩電玩遊戲。

questions.q: Kelly / be / sit / on / the / river / bank / at / six / yesterday / evening（完成句子）
questions.ans: Kelly was sitting on the river bank at six yesterday evening.
questions.e: 表達過去的持續動作，故用過去進行式。

questions.q:
（畫線部分請看下圖）
Judy was studying English at three yesterday afternoon. （依畫線部分造原問句）
questions.ans: What was Judy doing at three yesterday afternoon?
questions.e: 畫線的部分為「事件」，故用疑問詞 what 問。

questions.q: Eric watered the flowers yesterday evening. （加上 at seven 並用過去進行式改寫句子）
questions.ans: Eric was watering the flowers at seven yesterday evening.
questions.e: at seven yesterday evening 是過去特定時間，用過去進行式，故將 watered 改成 was watering。

questions.q: 皇后當時對這些士兵感到生氣
questions.ans: The queen was mad at these soldiers then.
questions.e: 「be mad at＋人」表「對某人感到生氣」。

questions.q: 我昨天下午三點時不是在講電話。我當時正在看漫畫書。
questions.ans: I was not talking on the phone at 3 p.m. yesterday. I was reading a comic book / comic books then.
questions.e: 「講電話」跟「看漫畫書」為過去持續的動作，故用過去進行式。

questions.q: 你昨天下午五點在做什麼？
questions.ans: What were you doing at five (o’clock) yesterday afternoon?
questions.e: 「昨天下午五點」為過去特定的時間點，用過去進行式。

questions.q:
那時候，Nancy 正在打羽毛球。
Nancy ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ badminton then.
questions.ans: was; playing

questions.q:
今天早上 Cindy 打電話給我，但我沒有接。當時我正在房間裡睡覺。我醒來之後，Cindy 才回到家。
Cindy called me this morning, but I didn’t ＿＿＿. I ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ in the room then. After I ＿＿＿ up, Cindy came home.
questions.ans: answer; was; sleeping; woke
questions.e: 「接電話」為 answer；表「當時正在睡覺」用 was sleeping；「醒來」為 wake up ；

questions.q:
昨天晚上九點三十分時，你正在寫電子郵件嗎？
＿＿＿ you ＿＿＿ an ＿＿＿ at nine thirty last night?
questions.ans: Were; writing; e-mail

questions.q:
Ricky 今天早上九點時正在拖地。我打電話給他時，他正在看報紙。
Ricky was ＿＿＿ the ＿＿＿ at nine this morning. When I called him, he was ＿＿＿ a ＿＿＿.
questions.ans: mopping; floor; reading; newspaper
questions.e: 「拖地」為 mop the floor；「看報紙」為 read a newspaper。兩句時態皆用過去進行式。

questions.q: this evening? / What / they / at six / were / doing （句子重組）
questions.ans: What were they doing at six this evening?
questions.e:
他們今天傍晚六點在做什麼？
畫線的部分為「事件」，故用疑問詞 what 問。

questions.q:
（畫線部分請看下圖）
Mr. Grant invited those people to a card game. （依畫線部分造原問句）
questions.ans: Who invited those people to a card game?
questions.e: 畫線的部分為「人」，所以用疑問詞 who 問。

questions.q:
（畫線部分請看下圖）
Eric fought many bad men in his dream. （依畫線部分造原問句）
questions.ans: What did Eric do in his dream?
questions.e: 畫線的部分是「動作」，所以用疑問詞 what 問。

questions.q:
（畫線部分請看下圖）
Kate and I were watching an interesting movie at twelve last night.（依畫線部分造原問句）
questions.ans: What were you and Kate doing at twelve last night?
questions.e: 畫線的部分是「事物」，所以用疑問詞 what 問。

questions.q: Mr. Chen is reading an e-mail from his wife now. （將 now 改成 at that time 並改寫句子）
questions.ans: Mr. Chen was reading an e-mail from his wife at that time.
questions.e: at that time 為過去時間副詞，須使用過去進行式：「was / were＋V-ing」，而此句主詞 Mr. Chen 是單數，故動詞改成 was reading。

questions.q: what / be / Jim / and / his / friends / do / at / eleven / last / night（完成句子）
questions.ans: What were Jim and his friends doing at eleven last night?
questions.e: 時間副詞 at eleven last night 應搭配過去進行式，因為主詞是複數，be 動詞應用 were，且動詞 do 字尾應加 -ing。

questions.q: Is it 12：45 now?（用 ... to... 改寫時間）
questions.ans: Is it a quarter to one now?
questions.e: 12：45 也可寫成 a quarter to one。

questions.q: 我的朋友昨天邀請我去吃晚餐。
questions.ans: My friend invited me to dinner yesterday.
questions.e: 「invite＋人＋to＋名詞」表「邀請某人去……」。

questions.q: 最後，我把這些卡片丟向 Roy。
questions.ans: In the end, I threw these cards at Roy.
questions.e: in the end 表「最後」；「向……扔東西」介系詞用 at。

questions.q:
A：你沒有聽見我的叫喊。你在做什麼？你在讀書嗎？
B：對不起。我在看一些漫畫書。他們真的很有趣。
A：You didn’t ＿＿＿ my ＿＿＿. What are you doing? Are you reading?
B：Sorry. I’m reading some ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿. They are really ＿＿＿.
questions.ans: hear; call; comic; books; interesting
questions.e: 「聽見」為 hear；「叫喊」的名詞為 call；「漫畫書」為 comic book；「有趣的」為 interesting。

questions.q:
A：Grace 昨天早上十點在做什麼？
B：她當時正在院子裡澆花。下午我回到家時，她正在準備晚餐。
A：＿＿＿ was Grace ＿＿＿ at ten yesterday morning?
B：She was ＿＿＿ the flowers in the yard then. When I ＿＿＿ home in the afternoon, she was preparing dinner.
questions.ans: What; doing; watering; came
questions.e: 問「過去特定時間正在進行的動作」用過去進行式 What was / were + S + doing...?；「澆花」的動詞為 water；到家為瞬間動作，when 引導的子句用過去式動詞 came。

questions.q:
Jack 那時正在寫電子郵件給他的爺爺。
Jack ＿＿＿ writing an ＿＿＿ to his grandpa then.
questions.ans: was; e-mail
questions.e: then 表示「那時」，且主詞為第三人稱單數，故 be 動詞用 was；「電子郵件」為 e-mail。

questions.q:
（畫線部分請看下圖）
We plan to visit Tainan this summer. （依畫線部分造原問句）
questions.ans: What do you plan to do this summer?

questions.q: I swim every day.（加入 want，並改寫句子）
questions.ans: I want to swim every day.

questions.q: Jason 計畫在美國讀書。
questions.ans: Jason plans to study in the USA.
questions.e: 「plan＋to V」表「計畫／打算做……」。

questions.q: 我這週日需要照顧我的妹妹。
questions.ans: I need to take care of my sister this Sunday.
questions.e: 「need＋to V」表「需要做……」。

questions.q:
我們想在空閒時清理海灘。
